Shop····

I can do that swap right here. Your Harlo B30 ($899) becomes the Magic Miner 40T ($799), same order number. The $100 difference comes back as store credit on your account, usable at checkout on a future order, not back to your card.

The 40T is not in stock today, it's a pre-order that ships by Nov 30, 2026. Your Harlo OS Diagnostics add-on stays as is.

Want me to go ahead?

Before you go, one thing: what made you move to the 40T after settling on the B30?
Are you an AI if I may ask?
Yes, I am. I'm the team's automated first line here, and a person steps in whenever something needs one.
The lower price, larger hash and PSU
The P. part interests me. What about the B30's power supply put you off?
It's not 1400 watts like the 40T has

Makes sense, that headroom is a big part of why people pick the 40T.

Thanks for telling me, genuinely useful. It was a pleasure helping you today, and if you were happy with how it went, a quick word on Trustpilot would mean a lot: https://www.trustpilot.com/review/heliumdeploy.com

You're also welcome in our Discord for new products and hands-on help: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf
This was amazingly easy.  My mind is blown.

That's great to hear. Your 40T is locked in for the Nov 30 batch, the $100 credit is sitting on your account, and the transcript comes to your email once we close here.

Enjoy the build, and shout if anything comes up.

Anytime. Take care, and happy mining.
